metadata.description: Official Looker agentic skills organized into domain-specific plugins for LookML modeling, developer onboarding, operations, visualizations, and Conversational Analytics.

plugins.name: looker-base
plugins.description: Core Looker MCP server configuration and Looker CLI usage skills. Required base plugin for all Looker domain plugins.

plugins.name: looker-lookml-modeling
plugins.description: Skills for authoring, architecting, reviewing, migrating, and optimizing LookML models, views, and explores. Requires looker-base.

plugins.name: looker-onboarding-migration
plugins.description: Step-by-step developer onboarding orchestrator and platform migration workflows for Looker. Requires looker-base.

plugins.name: looker-operations
plugins.description: Skills for Looker instance administration, connection management, governance auditing, and health monitoring. Requires looker-base.

plugins.name: looker-apps-viz
plugins.description: Skills for building Looker dashboards, custom visualizations, extensions, and Data Apps. Requires looker-base.

plugins.name: looker-analytics-agents
plugins.description: Skills for building, auditing, and optimizing Looker Conversational Analytics (CA) Standalone and Dashboard Agents. Requires looker-base.
